stage: 4L6 Wine-driven validation exports, driver display modes and compressed texture creation
changes: D3D8 validation exports return owned process-heap strings and correct null/version/caps failures; declarations and constant ranges use the shared creation parser.
D3D8 mode enumeration uses the actual driver 16/32-bit lists; CheckDeviceType restricts display/backbuffer pairs.
Common 8/9 2D and cube constructors reject non-block-aligned top-level DXT dimensions in every pool while retaining tiny mip levels.

upstream.modifications: None. MinGW build defines STANDALONE and an empty DECLSPEC_EXPORT; test bodies and expectations remain upstream bytes.

acceptanceScope.projectOwned: compressed_creation_group: DXT1-5, four pools, 1-8 dimensions, 2D/cube, full mip chains and tiny-level uploads
